blocks.text: 14.2 mein ginwai gai pollutants ki gyarah qismein 14.4.1 se 14.4.11 mein yake baad deegre bayan hain: har ek kahan se aata hai aur kya karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun si pollutant qismein zyada tar na-mukammal jalne se paida hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Carbon monoxide, bina jale hydrocarbons, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, volatile organic compounds aur kajal ka particulate matter sab fuels ke bohat kam oxygen ke saath jalne se bante hain; mukammal jalna zyada tar carbon dioxide aur pani deta hai.

items: 14.4.1 se 14.4.11 gyarah pollutant qismon mein se har ek ke zaraye aur asrat bayan karte hain.
